## Description
Brief summary of the changes and the step/milestone addressed (e.g. `Step 1.B.1`).

## Branch Reference
Branch name: `feat/<track>-<step>` (e.g. `feat/B-1.B.1-llm-provider`)

## Track Affected
- [ ] Track A: Frontend & Animations
- [ ] Track B: Agents & LangGraph
- [ ] Track C: RAG & Ingestion
- [ ] Track D: Backend, DB & Deployment
- [ ] Contract Change (PR labelled `contract` — requires approval from all tracks)

## Definition of Done Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles and passes linter / type checks
- [ ] Automated tests added and passing
- [ ] Step's Acceptance Check demonstrated and documented
- [ ] Corresponding item in `process.md` ticked
- [ ] Zero secrets or plaintext credentials committed
- [ ] Local-only privacy invariants preserved
